newsitem.title: USA: Trenton Savings two-tier status approved.
newsitem.headline: Trenton Savings two-tier status approved.

text.p: Trenton Savings Bank said on Thursday it received approval from the U.S. Office of Thrift Supervision for its reorganization into a two-tier mutual holding company.
Trenton said it expects to complete the reorganization in the second or third quarter of 1997.

Peoples Bancorp MHC, the bank's existing holding company, would own a majority of the new holding company's common shares. The new company would own 100 percent of the bank. The plan will be presented to shareholders at the company's annual meeting scheduled for April 25.
Under the proposed plan, each Trenton Savings share would be exchanged for a share in the new holding company.
The company said the new structure would improve its ability to invest through the mid-tier holding company, and make mergers and acquisitions easier to accomplish.
Trenton, with assets of over $630 million, has 14 branch offices in Burlington, Mercer and Ocean counties in New Jersey.
